module: "Audio Forest Editor" edit mode of the level editor: configures a forest ambience sound from the trees of the Forest object. The tool builds a node graph (minimum spacing 20 m) from the included forest instances, classifies them as S/M/L according to the volume of their bounding box, sends this cloud to the runtime module core/audioForest and gives it the main event (default 'event:>Ambient>Ambiences>Forest_Static') and an optional "roomtone" ('event:>Ambient>Ambiences>Roomtone'). The window lets you exclude tree types, choose the class of each type, adjust the node visualization and select a type by clicking in the view. The state is persisted with the level through onSerialize / onDeserialized.
notes: The file contains almost only local functions; only 4 functions are exported (hooks).
Depends on the modules core/audioForest, core/audioForest/audioForestCommon and editor/toolUtilities/(render/markup, render/graph, style).
Nodes are drawn within a radius of 1000 m by default, as 1.5 m spheres.
When the mode is activated, if no persisted state exists, all forest types are included.

onSerialize.desc: Returns the tool state as a table (version=1, visualization radii, showNodes, mainEvent, roomtoneEnabled/Event/Z, selectedRow, includeByShape, classSelByShape, classOverrideByShape) for level persistence and the runtime.

onDeserialized.desc: Receives the persisted state after level load; keeps it pending, marks the forest list as to be refreshed and rebuilds the node cloud if the mode is active. Ignores data that is not a table.

onEditorGui.desc: Called every editor frame: if the mode is active, refreshes the type list, draws the window, handles tree hover/selection and draws the graph nodes (and the centroid of the main emitter).

onEditorInitialized.desc: Registers the audioForestEditMode edit mode (create_forest icon) and the "audioForestEditor" window (520x820).
